text:
zoe: quick support ticket — onboarding quickstart curl uses the wrong env var name and a trailing space, customers are getting 401s and duplicate POSTs.
harry: can you paste the snippet from the README?
zoe: current README shows:
```
curl -X POST \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API " \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hi"}' \n  --retry 2
```
mina: two problems: wrong env var ($REDWOOD_API vs $REDWOOD_KEY) and trailing space after the token. plus `--retry` on a POST without an Idempotency-Key is dangerous.
harry: also noticed Java quickstart docs say client auto-retries, but Python quickstart shows an explicit RetryConfig example. SDK parity mismatch — confusing for integrators.
docs-bot: automated linter flagged the Authorization header trailing-space pattern. Suggested PR to fix env var name, remove trailing space, and add idempotency example.
zoe: opening a small PR to (1) change env var to $REDWOOD_KEY, (2) remove trailing space in header, (3) add an explicit Idempotency-Key example for POSTs, (4) add a short "Retries & idempotency" callout and align Java/Python retry guidance.
support: customer confirmed workaround by updating their script to remove the trailing space. thanks.
deploy-bot: PR opened and merged to main; staging docs updated at https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/quickstart. :shipit:
eng-runtime: FYI server behavior is strict-match on token; trimming might hide real rotation mistakes. raising for eng discussion.
mina: filing SDK parity issue #5102 to align retry guidance across languages.
zoe: closing loop — small README fixes but big impact. thanks everyone! :tada:
